internal.title: Incident Summary: High Latency in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 12:34 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered due to high p95 latency in the ad service, reaching 1.8 seconds, exceeding the threshold. Concurrently, elevated latency was observed in the checkout and frontend services, contributing to the overall system latency. The primary hypothesis identified the ad service latency as the root cause. 

Actions taken included disabling the 'adHighCpu' flag at 12:54 UTC after approval, which led to a rapid recovery with latency dropping back to normal levels (0.12 seconds p95).

The incident was resolved promptly after the flag was disabled, and normal service performance was verified. Further monitoring continues to ensure stability.

external.title: Service Latency Issue Resolved
external.body: Between 12:34 and 12:54 UTC on 2026-11-08, customers may have experienced increased latency when using our ad service. We identified and addressed the issue promptly, and normal service performance has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

output.summary: High latency in the ad service caused increased response times affecting customers. The issue was resolved by disabling a specific configuration flag, restoring normal latency levels.
output.impact: Customers experienced slower response times from the ad service, potentially affecting ad delivery and user experience during the incident window.
output.root_cause: The root cause was high CPU usage in the ad service, indicated by the 'adHighCpu' flag being enabled, which led to increased latency. Disabling this flag resolved the issue.
output.resolution: The 'adHighCpu' flag was disabled after approval, resulting in immediate latency improvement and service recovery.

lessons.lesson: Monitor CPU usage flags closely and have automated rollback procedures for flags that impact latency to reduce incident duration.
lessons.applies_when: When high CPU usage flags are enabled causing latency issues in the ad service.

action_items: Implement automated monitoring and alerting for CPU usage flags in the ad service.
Develop and test automated rollback mechanisms for flags that cause service degradation.
